usage: The word '炒白菜' refers to a vegetable dish commonly served in Cantonese restaurants.
'炒白菜' can be used as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about food.
When ordering food, you can say '我想要一份炒白菜' to specify the dish you want.
It often appears in menus under vegetable dishes and is recognized as a simple, healthy option.
'炒白菜' is a countable noun, so you can say '一份炒白菜' for one serving.
